R01.test_selection: all strict-eligible original cached test clips; no label-value selection
R01.phase_source: direct VLM pixels at EVERY selected fit/cal/test observation; no MLP
R01.encoder: frozen CLIP ViT-B/16 full and individual crops; real GDINO+ByteTrack extraction
R01.process: direct VLM consistency + normal-fitted transition surprisal; past-only context
R01.phase_unknown: global feature fallback; semantic unavailable is not normal
R01.threshold: separate normal calibration q99; strict >; fixed before test metrics
R01.limitations: small normal fit/cal, coarse sampling, previously inspected tests, no human state/bbox GT; not all16
R01.improvement_basis: observed normal-only state errors; test labels not used for prompt design
